test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 2 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

Shikha said, “The heavy rain this week has spoiled all my travel plans.”

options.text: Shikha said that the heavy rain that week had spoiled all her travel plans.
Shikha told me that the heavy rain that week had spoiled all her travel plans.
Shikha said that the heavy rain that week has spoiled all her travel plans.
Shikha said that the heavy rain this week had spoiled all her travel plans.

solution:
Here the correct answer is **Shikha said that the heavy rain that week had spoiled all her travel plans.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **direct speech.**
